title: Cops & Robbers
players: 4 teams: 3 robber teams and 1 cop team (source)
equipment: Proposed: balls, cones, four colours of pinnies.
setup: Mark a central bank and team hideouts. Agree safe tagging.
instructions: Robbers evade cops, collect a bank ball and return to their hideout.
Cops tag robbers before they reach the bank.
The source sends tagged players home to count ten. The proposed support option changes this to protect involvement.
support: Proposed option: Replace waiting with an immediate fresh start from the hideout; proposed change to source.
challenge: Proposed option: Cops may steal a ball and return it to the bank (source progression); keep all children able to rejoin.
observe: Can the child spot a route before entering?
